title: pkinative-cli AI Governance Configuration
description: Machine-readable contract governing how AI coding agents may propose issues, contributions, and changes to pkinative-cli. Agents that scan repository configuration on initialization MUST honour this file. See .github/AGENT_RULES.md for the human-and-agent-readable protocol.
anti_goals: network access of any kind (fetching CRLs, OCSP responses, timestamps, AIA or intermediate certificates)
accepting a password or any other secret on argv
a configuration file that relaxes a check or a bound (--allow-*, --max-*, --ber, --pem-mode, --overwrite, a password source)
printing private key material in any output, report or envelope

human_in_the_loop.gate: A human MUST explicitly review, sign off on, and trigger any GitHub issue, comment, PR, or release. The agent's authority ends at producing a local draft plus a compliance report.
human_in_the_loop.identity_integrity: Any issue or PR is published under the human user's GitHub identity. The agent MUST remind the user of their shared responsibility for the content before submission.
human_in_the_loop.attribution: Commits and pull requests carry no Co-Authored-By trailer, no 'generated with' footer and no other AI attribution.

compliance_report.description: The structured summary an agent MUST present to the user alongside every draft.

capability_manifest.description: Authoritative project context an agent SHOULD load before proposing changes.
capability_manifest.$comment: on_demand: load lazily by topic. The two surface matrices say which pkinative export each command reaches and which engine change each test holds.

claude_code.description: How the policy is enforced inside a Claude Code session (settings, hook, skills).

hooks.matcher: Bash|PowerShell — one matcher for every tool that reaches a shell; a hook that is never invoked parses nothing
hooks.command: node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/guard.mjs" — absolute through CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, so the guard runs whatever the working directory
hooks.scope: whole command, every shell segment, $( ) and backtick bodies, sh/bash/zsh -c, pwsh/powershell -Command, node -e and npx -c payloads; fails closed on unreadable input

claude_code.permissions_deny: Read on generated bulk files (package-lock.json, coverage/**, dist/**, test-output/**, node_modules/**, the engine snapshot docs/data/pkinative/api.frozen.json), and the HITL commands above denied once per shell tool — Bash(...) and PowerShell(...) — since a family denied for one and allowed for the other is not denied

skills.name: release-audit
skills.purpose: The pre-release audit, with its GO/NO-GO ledger under .audit/<version>/; run by the maintainer, never by the model on its own (disable-model-invocation: true).
